title: Now
subtitle: What Soumitra is focused on this month — without a blog post.
intro: Inspired by Derek Sivers' /now page. Updated about once a month.

sections.question: What am I working on?
paragraphs: Personal finance manager is done and dusted. Made git repo public.
Built an youtube video summarizer tool using ollama and gpt-4o-mini. Next up is personal health tracker app.

Also building a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) and agentic AI system designed to run entirely inside a sealed, air-gapped environment — with no external network connectivity at any point.

sections.question: What am I learning?
paragraphs: Fine tuning was an amazing experience, between local ollama and google colab's T4. A few project ideas popped up.
Reading about the history of AI and the future of AI. And how to build a successful AI company.

sections.question: What excites me?
paragraphs: The shift from "AI as a feature" to "AI as a teammate" — especially in domains where domain expertise still matters (connectivity, fintech, research).

The other constant is space and physics — the kind of "how does the universe actually work" content that has nothing to do with a deadline and everything to do with staying curious. Space-time continuum, cosmology, the physics of everyday things — it's the counterweight to the AI deep-dives, and honestly just as fun. Have to finish watching the sci fi short films in my youtube playlist.
